major_features: Interactive visual grid of formatting anomalies
Automatic column data-type inference and mismatch highlighting
Instant export of sanitized CSV files with encoding repairs
candidate_ideas.name: CSV Schema Guard
candidate_ideas.pain: Hours spent debugging cryptic database import errors or writing throwaway scripts to find a single rogue comma or unescaped quote in a 50,000-row file.
candidate_ideas.problem: Incoming CSV files frequently have malformed rows, mismatched column counts, encoding glitches, or inconsistent date formats that break database import scripts.
candidate_ideas.solution: A completely local browser application where users drop a CSV file to instantly get a visual audit map of structural anomalies, duplicate headers, type mismatches (e.g., text in a numeric column), and non-ASCII character highlights, with one-click repair and export.
candidate_ideas.target_user: Data analysts, database administrators, and spreadsheet users.
candidate_ideas.verification: Load a mock CSV with variable column counts and mismatched data types in the browser, verify the UI highlights the exact row/column coordinates of the anomalies, and check that the exported CSV resolves those issues.

major_features: Visual reading-order map overlaid on rendered HTML wireframe
Generated text-to-speech script simulation showing exact screen reader announcements
Real-time warnings for missing landmarks, unlabeled controls, and focus traps
candidate_ideas.name: Semantic Speech Map
candidate_ideas.pain: Developers skip accessibility testing or miss critical reading-order bugs, resulting in highly frustrating experiences for visually impaired users.
candidate_ideas.problem: Evaluating how screen readers navigate and announce complex web page layouts is difficult without installing and learning complex screen reader software on multiple OS platforms.
candidate_ideas.solution: A local-first tool where developers paste raw HTML or a component's DOM structure to generate a sequential, interactive 'speech script'. It visually plots the exact reading order, announces role attributes, exposes missing alt texts, and flags keyboard focus traps.
candidate_ideas.verification: Paste an HTML snippet with missing alt tags and aria-labels, verify the tool generates a step-by-step reading order list highlighting these specific accessibility failures.

major_features: Interactive double-entry transaction builder with auto-balancing validation
Real-time balance sheet and income statement visualizations
Bidirectional syncing between visual editor and raw ledger text format
candidate_ideas.name: PlainText Ledger UI
candidate_ideas.pain: Typographical errors in account names, unbalanced transactions, and the friction of manually calculating compound entries without immediate visual feedback.
candidate_ideas.problem: Plain-text accounting (Ledger/Beancount) offers ultimate privacy and longevity, but writing journal entries manually in a text editor is error-prone and lacks real-time financial visualization.
candidate_ideas.solution: A local-first web interface that acts as a visual editor for plain-text ledger files. Users can drop their ledger file, use intuitive forms to log balanced transactions with auto-complete, and instantly view updated balance sheets and income statements generated entirely client-side.
candidate_ideas.target_user: Freelancers, micro-businesses, and personal finance enthusiasts using plain-text accounting.
candidate_ideas.verification: Drop a sample ledger string into the app, add a transaction via the UI form, verify it auto-balances, and confirm the generated ledger text file updates correctly without syntax errors.

major_features: Side-by-side matrix view of all translation files simultaneously
Automatic detection of missing keys, empty strings, and interpolation variable mismatches
One-click synchronization to add missing placeholder keys to lagging locales
candidate_ideas.name: Locale Align
candidate_ideas.pain: Production applications crashing or displaying ugly raw translation keys to end-users because of missing keys in secondary locale files.
candidate_ideas.problem: Managing translation JSON files across multiple languages leads to structural drift where keys are added, renamed, or deleted in one file but forgotten in others.
candidate_ideas.solution: A browser-based side-by-side comparison tool for localization files. Drop a folder of JSON files to view a unified translation matrix, automatically flagging missing keys, mismatched nesting structures, and inconsistent interpolation parameters (such as variable names).
candidate_ideas.verification: Upload two JSON files with mismatched keys and different variables, verify the tool displays a clear diff grid highlighting the missing keys and variable mismatches, and allows exporting the synchronized JSONs.

major_features: Visual grid designer with drag-and-drop text, barcode, and QR code elements
Local batch import via CSV to generate hundreds of labels instantly
Print-optimized CSS layouts configured for standard adhesive label sheets
candidate_ideas.name: LabelCraft Local
candidate_ideas.pain: Wasting expensive sheet labels due to poor alignment, complex design software learning curves, or lack of offline capability.
candidate_ideas.problem: Creating and printing custom barcode labels, price tags, or QR code signs requires expensive specialized software or subscription-based online tools that harvest business data.
candidate_ideas.solution: A completely offline browser utility designed to generate printable sheets of labels. Users can define custom grid layouts or use standard templates, input product metadata or import a list, generate barcodes/QR codes locally, and print perfect sheets using standard browser print-to-pdf.
candidate_ideas.target_user: Small retail shop owners, makers, and inventory managers.
candidate_ideas.verification: Generate a grid of labels with custom text and local QR codes, verify the print preview CSS aligns perfectly with standard label layouts, and test that generated QR codes are scannable.
